criteria.statement: The new compact-block builder's returned grid shape has at most 2 rows at every supported player count 2-8
At higher player counts the block grows wider (more columns), not taller, and never a ceil(sqrt(N)) square
Exactly one cell in the block is the viewer/self cell, at a fixed corner position, for every supported count
The new builder's block shape does not depend on layout.columns/layout.rows - same shape from seatArrangement and listSeatArrangement direction data for the same count
The new export has no React import and no import from lib/lifeTracker/state.ts
buildSeatMapCells's existing signature and behavior are unchanged - existing tests still pass unmodified
npm run test passes for seatMap.test.ts
